text: Clean edges: the net outputs sub-pixel edge fields (MSDF-like), rendered crisp at full resolution
description: Instead of blurry low-res colour, each cell outputs signed distances to nearby edges (like MSDF font rendering), so 64×48 cells reconstruct razor-sharp silhouettes at 2160×2160. This fits ink outlines and comic style. Alternative: depth-guided joint bilateral upsampling.

status.comment: Cancelled earlier: junctions where 3+ edges meet make edge fields complicated; replaced by the edge-restoring corridor net (029c7fcb). Archived in graph hygiene 2026-11-23.
